note: Which census rows go on the 'Non-code decisions' tab of docs/deferred.xlsx. Everything not listed here goes on 'Build'. The author's ruling, 2026-08-17: non-code decisions were confusing mixed in with build work. Correcting a mis-sort is one line — move an ID in or out of this list and re-run `pnpm deferred:xlsx`. Rows are MOVED, never altered: every column, including Disposition exactly as marked, is carried across unchanged.
criterion: The row's action is the author's and sits outside the repo — a ruling, a call, a signature or a purchase rather than a build. Where a row is genuinely both (a build blocked on a ruling), it goes to Build and is named as a judgment call in the run's output.

rulingOnly.note: Not in the author's enumerated lists, added under the 'any other row whose explainer asks for a ruling' clause. Each one's action is a decision and never a build.

closedSince.note: IDs removed from the lists above because their tracker rows CLOSED and left the census. Kept by name rather than deleted, so a later reader can see the list was corrected against a moving tracker rather than mis-typed. Removed 2026-08-18 (g19), when pnpm deferred:xlsx refused on them.
